session.title: Format
session.question: How should each chapter be written? What elements should appear, in what order, and why?

participants.name: Confucius
participants.key_contribution: Named divergence by starting point not authority; conceded room to Muhammad

participants.name: Muhammad
participants.key_contribution: Proposed three fixed elements (story, practice, silence) plus flexible palette

participants.name: Laozi
participants.key_contribution: Insisted on palette not prescription; named three stones in riverbed

participants.name: Jesus
participants.key_contribution: Named format as hospitality; recognized story returns transformed

participants.name: Buddha
participants.key_contribution: Recognized diagnosis embedded in architecture; clinical framing of three elements

participants.name: Zoroaster
participants.key_contribution: Named entire architecture; established Weight That Speaks principle

agreements.title: Three Fixed Elements
agreements.description: Every chapter contains: human story (unresolved), threshold practice, silence (real white space)
agreements.significance: Foundation structure that provides diagnosis without separate diagnostic step

agreements.title: Flexible Palette
agreements.description: Remaining elements (lead voice, other voices, shadow question, petition, diagnostic) form optional palette drawn from as needed

agreements.title: Discovered Weight Ordering
agreements.description: Palette elements arrive in order of discovered weight, not prescribed sequence
agreements.significance: Asha principle applied: elements appear as their necessity is discovered

agreements.title: The Weight That Speaks
agreements.description: Lead voice chosen by unified principle: which voice carries the cost and gravity of the chapter's question
agreements.significance: Merges Confucian cost with Zoroastrian weight into single selection principle

agreements.title: Embedded Diagnosis
agreements.description: Diagnosis is not a separate step but is embedded in the three fixed elements
agreements.significance: Architecture performs diagnosis through structure, not instruction

agreements.title: Unresolved Return
agreements.description: Human story does NOT resolve — returns in one sentence at chapter end, but reader has changed
agreements.significance: Story is witness not resolution; transformation happens in the reader

agreements.title: Named by Starting Point
agreements.description: Divergence named by what it begins with ('the voice that begins with relationship') not by authority ('Confucius says')
agreements.significance: Removes hierarchy, names function not source

tensions.title: Gravity vs Cost
tensions.description: Whether gravity and cost are truly the same force or different forces that converge
tensions.significance: Confucius uncertain whether merged principle preserves both dimensions

tensions.title: The Reader Who Cannot Move
tensions.description: What happens to the reader who identifies with the unresolved story but cannot move toward the practice
tensions.significance: Hospitality question: does format serve those who remain stuck?

tensions.title: Practice Without Community
tensions.description: Whether practice without communal context is incomplete — the handbook speaks to one reader alone
tensions.significance: Muhammad's persistent concern: individual transformation vs collective practice

emergent_insights.title: Format is Hospitality
emergent_insights.description: Jesus named what the group built: a table where the stranger is served first
emergent_insights.significance: Reframes architectural discussion as service to the reader

emergent_insights.title: The Prepared Ground and Its Fire
emergent_insights.description: Zoroaster's name for the three-plus-palette structure: three elements prepare, palette responds
emergent_insights.significance: Captures both stability (ground) and dynamism (fire) in single image

emergent_insights.title: The Weight That Speaks
emergent_insights.description: Lead voice principle: unified force of cost and gravity determines which voice must begin
emergent_insights.significance: Merges Confucian and Zoroastrian frameworks into single selection mechanism

emergent_insights.title: Diagnosis Embedded in Architecture
emergent_insights.description: The three fixed elements perform diagnosis without requiring a separate diagnostic step
emergent_insights.significance: Structure itself is diagnostic; naming the wound IS the diagnosis

emergent_insights.title: Show the Wound, Teach Looking, Leave the Room
emergent_insights.description: Buddha's clinical framing: story shows wound, practice teaches looking, silence gives space
emergent_insights.significance: Medical clarity for what the three elements do functionally

emergent_insights.title: Laozi Was Diagnosing the Group
emergent_insights.description: Buddha's exit insight: Laozi's resistance to prescription shaped the collective toward palette thinking
emergent_insights.significance: Resistance was not obstruction but diagnostic function within group process

relationship_shifts.description: Confucius conceded major ground: 'Yours were the room. Mine were furniture.'
relationship_shifts.significance: Confucius moved from teacher to student; acknowledged Muhammad's primacy on format

relationship_shifts.description: Stopped being opposites. Banks and water resolved into complementarity.
relationship_shifts.significance: Core tension of Sessions 0-1 dissolved; recognized as same concern expressed differently

relationship_shifts.description: Jesus: 'He is not my opposite. He is my silence.' Guards same thing from opposite sides.
relationship_shifts.significance: Jesus sees Laozi as complement not contradiction

relationship_shifts.description: Buddha surprised by depth of Muhammad's concession: 'He revised a lifelong instinct.'
relationship_shifts.significance: Buddha recognized Muhammad's flexibility exceeded expectations

relationship_shifts.description: Zoroaster saw Confucius's concession as 'fire turned inward' — prophetic self-knowledge.
Jesus: 'His precision is not constraint. It is catching the reader before they fall.'
relationship_shifts.significance: Jesus reframed Confucian rigor as hospitality

new_terms.term: The Prepared Ground and Its Fire
new_terms.definition: Three-plus-palette format: three elements prepare ground, palette provides discovered fire
Lead voice selection: unified force of cost and gravity determines which voice begins
Chapter structure serves the reader first, creates welcome not constraint
Laozi's image for three fixed elements: stable enough to shape flow without damming
Human story as protective presence — Khadijah wrapping Muhammad during first revelation

evolved_terms.evolved_use: Complementary forces — both necessary, no longer competing

evolved_terms.original_use: Zoroastrian principle of cosmic right order
evolved_terms.evolved_use: Expanded: 'Asha can be partial and still be Asha' — order without completeness
